description: FastCDC content-defined chunking golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). Xia et al. USENIX ATC 2016 (arXiv:1706.03410). Pure wrapping uint64: GEAR[i] = SplitMix64.mix(i); rolling hash = (hash<<1)+GEAR[byte]; normalized masks 2^15-1 (offset<avg) / 2^11-1 (offset>=avg); skip first `min` bytes; force a cut at `max`; flush the trailing remainder. To keep the seed tiny while exercising real content-defined cuts on large streams, each oracle DETERMINISTICALLY GENERATES the byte stream as byte[i] = mix(i) & 0xFF (gen='splitmix-low8'), chunks it, and the chunk LENGTHS (which fully determine the boundaries) are cross-verified. gearSamples spot-checks the table construction. uint64 carried as decimal strings; lengths are ints.
